title: Surface-Code Quantum Error Correction for Molecular Tweezer Arrays: Encoding, Layout, and Correlated Noise
summary: Polar molecules trapped in optical tweezer arrays offer a promising platform for quantum information processing, providing precise control and long-range interactions that enable high-fidelity gate operations. We investigate quantum error correction in this system and show the influence of underlying physical noise.
